title: A Relaxing Transfer to Lisbon
text: Fabio was an excellent driver and guide. The overall experience was relaxing and informative, much more satisfying than a flight experience and, in this case, less expensive.
author: Andrew_O

title: Road trip to Sevilla
text: Cesar was very informative, knew his history well, and could even give us details of the Fauna.  He was flexible with us when we stopped for lunch and very kind.
author: 983robertp

title: Great trip, great guide!
text: We had a wonderful trip from Seville to Lisbon, stopping at several great towns along the way. Cesar was very personable, sharing history of and info about Portugal and Lisbon along the way. His car was large, clean and comfortable. We decided on this tour because our last stop on a two-week Spain/Portugal vacation was Lisbon, and we thought a road trip would be more interesting (and not much longer door-door) than flying. Our every expectation was met!
author: DayTrip61898405480
